messages:
Dara (CSE): Aurora onboarding hit a burst of 429s during their smoke test. Started ~11:00 UTC. Customer says it spikes when many ephemeral-bearing workers start.

aurora-eng: Paste from our side: `2026-07-21T11:00:03Z POST /v1/embeddings 429 rate_limit tenant=aurora proc=worker-12` then `2026-07-21T11:00:04Z ephemeral refresh ok id=tkn_q1w2` then retries. ~70 parallel inits.

Omar (Platform): Sounds like token churn + preflight fanout. Which SDK versions and are they doing per-process fetches?

Dara (CSE): They're using server-js 2.0.0 across many short-lived containers; each container fetches ephemeral token on start. No splay.

Liu (SDK): Quick mitigations: 1) per-process token cache or sidecar; 2) randomized init jitter (100-350ms); 3) cap parallel preflight fetches to 3. We can ship a tiny patch to 2.0.x today.

deploy-bot: Note: 2026-07-21T02:15:00Z token-service canary changed ephemeral_grace from 12s -> 4s (owner: infra/token-service).

Omar (Platform): That explains it. Ops can add a tenant exception for grace and a temporary burst slot for onboarding. @ops-oncall can you apply a 30-60m override?

ops-oncall: Applying tenant override: ephemeral_grace=12s, tenant_burst_slot=true for tenant=aurora for 45m. Watching concurrent_init metric.

aurora-eng: Thanks — after override errors dropped quickly. We rolled a feature-flagged splay and saw failures reduce from 22% -> 1.5% in staging.

Liu (SDK): I'll open PR SDK-812: "server-js: init splay + token cache + maxParallelFetches" and cut patch 2.0.1. Also adding recommended patterns to onboarding KB.

Dara (CSE): Customer asked for docs and for a short postmortem note for their renewal pack. I'll draft the account health update and schedule a 20-min call to demo mitigation.

ops-oncall: Removing tenant override at 11:45 UTC; no regressions observed.

Omar (Platform): Follow-ups: revert the ephemeral_grace reduction in canary until we validate SDK rollout; add alert for concurrent_init spikes per tenant; add KB link to CSE playbook.

Dara (CSE): Closing loop — Aurora confirms stable in prod and appreciated quick ops+SDK help. Will include KB link in renewal outreach. :tada:
